lines.say: Plant protein or animal protein for muscle?
Animal protein, like eggs, milk and chicken, has all the building blocks, and lots of leucine, the switch for muscle building.
Many plant proteins have a bit less leucine, or are low in one building block. Mixing sources, like rice and beans, fixes that.
In one study, vegans and meat eaters eating the same amount of protein built the same muscle in twelve weeks.
The trick: eat enough total protein. Plant eaters may need a little more, or can use soy or pea protein.
Verdict: both work. Total protein matters most.
Dal, tofu, paneer, eggs or chicken: pick what you enjoy.
